intended_behavior: Extend agent_workflow to invoke a newly added onWorkflowCompletion callback with the final workflow result (final_message) when the workflow completes. This invocation should happen after all processing, logging, and state handling to allow programmatic retrieval of results without disrupting existing flow or replay behavior.

Add an onWorkflowCompletion callback property to DurableAgent allowing users to register a handler for workflow completions. Internally, wire this callback such that it is called automatically inside agent_workflow or equivalent upon workflow completion with the result data.

Optionally add or modify a method on DurableAgent for running workflows that supports the onWorkflowCompletion callback registration and coordination with the underlying workflow execution lifecycle, making it easy for end users to start workflows and get notified about completions programmatically.
